decisions: Create semantic-types-and-ids as a superseding plan rather than patching semantic-ids.PLAN.md in place.
Keep contract IDs, message IDs, and rendered text as separate concepts.
Do not add go-i18n in this implementation slice.
Use Go defined types for high-risk semantic values; aliases are only temporary compatibility bridges.
Prefer domain-owned type definitions over a global IDs package.
Allow raw primitives at I/O boundaries and parse into semantic values internally.
Keep existing English messages and compatibility JSON fields while adding messageId.
Treat MCP as an agent-facing contract that needs typed tool IDs and message IDs.
Keep existing frontend data-testid locators and add semantic data attributes selectively.
Use scans to triage fragile English assertions rather than automatically deleting all text assertions.
